title: Special Delivery
description: Scheduled reports are generated asynchronously (FR-1303) — the CSV isn't ready the instant you request it. Request one, and prove it actually goes through a pending state before becoming downloadable, and that the download matches what the synchronous summary would say.
successCondition: POST /api/reporting/jobs returns 202 with a job whose status is not yet "ready". Polling GET /api/reporting/jobs/:id eventually shows status "ready". GET /api/reporting/jobs/:id/download then returns a CSV (Content-Type text/csv) whose per-row shipmentCount/revenueCents match the equivalent GET /api/reporting/summary call for the same from/to/groupBy/timeZone. GET .../download before the job is ready returns 409.
hints: NOTIFICATION_QUEUE_DELAY_MS also controls how long report jobs take to become ready (see docs/api/reporting.md) — lower it for faster local iteration if you're impatient.
A test that only checks once, immediately after POST /api/reporting/jobs, will falsely conclude generation is synchronous — poll with a timeout instead.
